page_title: FIO 2-1 ACM | Fiorentina v AC Milan 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Pointless reaction! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) receives a red card for unsporting behaviour after the final whistle.
90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+4' OFF THE BAR! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
90+3' Andrea Colpani comes off the pitch to be replaced by Michael Kayode (Fiorentina).

90+1' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The corner kick from Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

89' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
89' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
87' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
86' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

86' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but David de Gea thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.
85' Referee Luca Pairetto has finally had enough of Raffaele Palladino and gives him a straight RED CARD!
84' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David de Gea intercepts the ball.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) will replace Christian Pulisic.
82' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
81' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Yacine Adli will be replaced by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina).
77' Here comes a substitution. Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Albert Gudmundsson.

76' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
76' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but David de Gea comes off his line to gather the ball.

73' 2 - 1 Brilliant finish! Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Moise Kean, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:1.
73' Substitution. Rafael Leao did his best and is replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
72' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

71' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, David de Gea anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
70' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
69' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
68' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Christian Pulisic, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
67' It's time for a substitution. Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Danilo Cataldi.
67' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
64' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just over the bar.
63' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
62' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

60' 1 - 1 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) meets a perfect cross from Theo Hernandez deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:1.
56' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the left post, but David de Gea leaps out to thwart his attempt.
56' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
55' Referee Luca Pairetto is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to AC Milan!
54' Celebrations by AC Milan are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
54' Luca Pairetto couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) and blew his whistle. Penalty awarded! AC Milan will take a penalty kick.
54' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
53' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and it's Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
52' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) sprays a pass out to Alvaro Morata, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
50' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
50' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) attempts to find Rafael Leao with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
48' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
48' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) sends a long ball in, but David de Gea comfortably gathers the ball.
47' A clumsy foul by Emerson Royal (AC Milan) and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the right side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from David de Gea.
45+2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) takes a short corner kick.
45+2' The referee awards a corner and Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) goes over to take it.

45+1' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. David de Gea anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
45+1' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) tackles a bit over-zealously and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul. AC Milan are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
44' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) sends a long ball in, but Mike Maignan comfortably gathers the ball.
43' This is a yellow card! Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
42' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is quick to pick up the loose pass from Moise Kean. He tries his luck from mid-range, but it goes well wide of the right post.
39' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.

37' That didn't go as planned! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past David de Gea, who easily kept it out.

35' 1 - 0 Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) scores a goal after an exquisite individual effort! He skips past a few defenders and pulls the trigger from just outside the box. He sends the ball towards the bottom right corner and it glances in off the post.
34' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
32' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends it out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
32' Paulo Fonseca isn't happy on the touchline after referee Luca Pairetto shows him a yellow card.

31' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the roof of the net, but David de Gea earns his money with a fine reflex save. AC Milan earn a corner.
29' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out for offside!

28' Emerson Royal sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well over the bar.
28' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan will take a free kick near the side line.
25' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
24' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
22' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan leaps out to thwart his attempt.
22' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
20' It’s a PENALTY to Fiorentina after the VAR review!

19' Play continues despite the shouts by some Fiorentina players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Luca Pairetto interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
19' Dodo (Fiorentina) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
18' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) sends a low pass into the box, towards Moise Kean. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
17' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
15' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post!
13' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.

12' So close! Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
11' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
9' Christian Pulisic swings in the free kick towards Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan), who powers a header high over the bar from close in.
8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dodo (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
8' AC Milan are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
3' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
1' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Fiorentina will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Luca Pairetto.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
